categories.main_business_segments: Lee & Man Paper Manufacturing Limited operates primarily in three segments: packaging paper (including kraft linerboard, test linerboard, coated duplex board, white top linerboard, and high strength corrugating medium), tissue paper, and pulp production. The company sells these products directly to customers, with packaging paper being the core business segment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group employs advanced papermaking and pulping technologies, including environmentally friendly ultra-low emission technology and biomass fuel usage to replace coal-fired power generation. It uses automated and computer-monitored production processes, high-efficiency air emission treatment facilities such as circulating fluidised bed boilers, SCR/SNCR denitration systems, and limestone-gypsum flue gas desulfurisation. The company also applies sophisticated sewage treatment techniques combining coagulation-sedimentation, anaerobic and aerobic digestion, and Fenton deep treatment, with real-time monitoring systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The Group serves customers primarily in the packaging, tissue paper, and pulp industries. Approximately 89% of revenue is derived from external customers in Mainland China, with the remainder mainly from Malaysia and Vietnam. The company’s products cater to industries requiring packaging materials and hygiene products, benefiting from policies promoting paper packaging over plastic.
categories.geographic_coverage: Lee & Man operates manufacturing plants and facilities in multiple regions including Mainland China (Dongguan, Jiangsu, Guangdong, Chongqing, Jiangxi, Guangxi), Vietnam, and Malaysia. The Group’s registered office is in the Cayman Islands, with principal offices in Hong Kong. Its markets are primarily in China, Malaysia, and Vietnam, with export sales to countries along the Belt and Road initiative.
categories.supply_chain_position: The Group operates a vertically integrated supply chain, producing pulp, packaging paper, and tissue paper. It sources raw materials globally, including waste paper from the UK, US, and Canada, and processes them in its plants. The company manages upstream pulp production, midstream paper manufacturing, and downstream tissue paper production, ensuring control over raw material supply and cost efficiency.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group’s strategic focus includes technological upgrades to improve production efficiency and reduce costs, development of environmentally friendly products, and strengthening product research and development to meet diverse customer needs. It actively promotes integration of its industrial chain, invests in energy-saving and low-carbon technologies, and pursues sustainable development with clear environmental targets for emission reductions and resource efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of packaging paper, tissue paper, and pulp products. Sales are recognized at a point in time when control of goods transfers to customers, typically upon delivery. The Group also earns income from supply of steam and electricity, rental income from investment properties, and other ancillary services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, Lee & Man Paper is positioned as a leading paper manufacturing company in China and ranks among the top ten paper manufacturing companies globally. It emphasizes cost advantages through overseas production bases and vertical integration, aiming to maintain competitiveness amid market challenges and regulatory changes.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended 2024, the Group reported revenue of approximately HK$26.0 billion, a 4.2% increase from the previous year, and a profit of HK$1.36 billion, up 17.6%. Total assets reached HK$55.35 billion, with net assets of HK$28.01 billion. The Group has a workforce exceeding 10,000 employees and continues to invest in property, plant, and equipment to expand operations. Earnings per share increased to HK30.56 cents from HK24.39 cents in 2023.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Lee & Man Paper emphasizes its vertically integrated business model, enabling economies of scale and cost control. It differentiates through environmentally friendly production technologies, high-quality and sustainable paper products, including 100% recycled raw materials for packaging paper and innovative tissue paper products with natural bamboo fibers. The Group also focuses on strong corporate governance, risk management, and social responsibility to create value for stakeholders.
